## berth host rm

forget a host and revoke berth's key there (refused while it has orgs, unless --force)

### Synopsis

forget a host and revoke berth's key there (refused while it has orgs, unless --force)

Docs: https://ar4mirez.github.io/berth/reference/commands/berth_host_rm/

```
berth host rm <name> [--force] [flags]
```

### Examples

```

  berth host rm box1 --force
```
